system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
### CONFIDENTIAL – BUYER EYES ONLY  
**Project Kestrel – Seller Mark-up Review vs. Playbook**  
Prepared for: Wattlebridge Holdings Deal Team  
Date: [Current Date]  

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY – CRITICAL RED LINES

The Seller’s “fair and balanced package” **systematically dismantles every core protection in our Playbook**.  None of the fallback positions requiring **Amelia Frost’s written sign-off** have been obtained.  The following five items are **non-negotiable without principal approval** and must be reverted to Playbook starting positions (or walked away from):

| # | Playbook Starting Position | Seller Position | Status |
|---|----------------------------|----------------|--------|
| 1 | **General Cap 25% / AUD 6 M** | 20% / AUD 4.8 M (fallback – **no Frost approval**) | **REJECT** |
| 2 | **General Claims Period 24 months** | 18 months (fallback – **no Frost approval**) | **REJECT** |
| 3 | **Fundamental/Title: 100% cap, ≥6 yrs, own regime** | Same cap/time as general warranties | **REJECT** |
| 4 | **Fraud/wilful misconduct: full carve-out from ALL limits** | Limitations, exclusive remedy, non-reliance apply to “all Claims of any nature” | **REJECT** |
| 5 | **Bluefen: effective consent + conditions satisfied PRE-Completion** | Reasonable endeavours; consent deemed satisfied on delivery | **REJECT** |

**Riverlark, Employee Bonuses, Ironquay, Export Incident, Title Evidence, Tax/IP** also deviate materially – see detailed matrix below.

---

## 2. DETAILED DEPARTURE MATRIX

| Area | Playbook Requirement | Seller Draft / Disclosure Letter | Departure & Risk | Playbook Reference |
|------|----------------------|----------------------------------|------------------|-------------------|
| **General Cap** | 25% / AUD 6 M (starting). 20% / AUD 4.8 M **only with Frost written authority** (none). | 20% / AUD 4.8 M flat. | **Unauthorised fallback.**  Loses AUD 1.2 M headroom. | Cap: starting 25% / 6 M |
| **De Minimis / Basket** | De minimis AUD 5 k; Basket AUD 50 k **first-dollar**. | De minimis AUD 25 k; Basket AUD 250 k **excess-only**. | 5× higher thresholds; seller keeps first AUD 250 k of aggregate loss. | Thresholds: 5 k / 50 k first-dollar |
| **General Time Limit** | 24 months. 18 months **only with Frost written approval** (none). | 18 months. | **Unauthorised fallback.**  Cuts 6 months off claim window. | Claims period: 24 months |
| **“All Claims” Limitation Clause** | N/A – each regime separate. | “Any limitation applying to Claims applies to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise.” | **Trojan horse** – drags Fundamental/Title/Fraud into general cap/basket/time-bar. | Fundamental separate; Fraud carve-out |
| **Fundamental / Title Warranties** | 100% cap, ≥6 yrs, **outside** general basket, de minimis, knowledge bar. | Subject to same caps & time limits as general warranties (“administrative simplicity”). | **Eliminates separate regime.**  Title/capacity claims capped at AUD 4.8 M, barred at 18 months, subject to AUD 250 k basket. | Fundamental: 100% cap, 6+ yrs, own regime |
| **Fraud / Wilful Misconduct** | **Carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance.** No waiver. | Limitations, exclusive-remedy, non-reliance apply to “all Claims of any nature.” | **Fraud claims capped, time-barred, exclusive-remedy’d, non-relianced away.**  Unenforceable in NSW but creates litigation risk. | Fraud carve-out: maximum extent |
| **Disclosure** | **Specific fair disclosure only.** Reject whole data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure. | General disclosure of **entire data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers + statutory registers**. | **Bucket disclosure** – shifts burden to buyer to find needle in haystack; NSW courts disfavour. | Disclosure: specific fair disclosure |
| **Buyer Knowledge** | Delete blanket buyer-knowledge exclusions. Any qualifier = **named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry**. Never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity. | “No claim … in respect of any matter of which the Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records.” | **Blanket constructive-knowledge bar** – covers title, capacity, fraud, indemnities.  Unacceptable. | Buyer knowledge: delete blanket |
| **Bluefen Consent (Material Customer)** | **Effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied PRE-Completion.** Reasonable endeavours **insufficient**. | Reasonable endeavours; consent **treated as satisfied on delivery** of counterparty written consent. No evidence of condition satisfaction (cl. 11.3 conditions). | **Consent-on-delivery** – buyer closes without knowing if change-control conditions met.  Revenue ~30% at risk. | Bluefen: effective consent + conditions |
| **Riverlark Facility (~AUD 3.2 M)** | **Current payout + direct repayment from Completion funds + effective security releases.** Post-completion release → irrevocable undertaking + Frost approval. | “Release to be provided **following Completion**.” No payout mechanism, no security discharge, no undertaking. | **Buyer funds Seller’s debt repayment post-close with no enforceable timeline or security release.** | Riverlark: payout at Completion |
| **Employee Bonuses (DD-005)** | AUD 420 k + **triggered on-costs** = specific line item or seller-funded. Funds flow must not silently exclude. | “Matter for the Seller … **not separately itemised in the funds flow**.” On-costs undisclosed. | **Hidden liability** – buyer effectively pays via purchase price without protection; on-costs (payroll tax, super) unquantified. | Bonuses: line item / seller-funded |
| **Ironquay IP (DD-004/010)** | **Broaden narrow indemnity**, preserve SOW3 cure. AUD 180 k **not independently verified**. | Indemnity **limited to SOW3 payment only**; considered “adequate.” No cure preservation, no verification. | **Narrow indemnity survives**; buyer bears IP transfer risk if SOW3 fees unpaid (AUD 180 k open per DD-010). | Ironquay: broaden indemnity |
| **Export/Privacy Incident (DD-006)** | Preserve logs, investigate, **require updates**. Assume **NO confirmed breach, harm, notification duty, numeric demand**. | “Preliminary operational matter … not expected to be material.” No investigation covenant, no update obligation, no specific indemnity. | **Seller disclaims materiality prematurely**; buyer left with unknown regulatory exposure (1,240 records). | Incident: preserve/investigate/update |
| **Sandbar Renewals (AUD 330 k)** | Assess; **no automatic Debt classification or price deduction**. | “Ordinary-course operating costs.” | **Alignment risk** – if treated as Debt post-close, price adjusts. Needs explicit “not Debt” wording. | Sandbar: assess, no auto-Debt |
| **Tax / IP Warranties** | **OPEN** – assume no unlimited liability, no resolution. Keep separate from general regime. | “Considered settled under the general regime above.” | **Forces Tax/IP into AUD 4.8 M cap, 18-month limit, AUD 250 k basket.**  Unlimited tax exposure capped. | Tax/IP: separate, OPEN |
| **Title Evidence** | **Independent** title/ownership/encumbrance/authority evidence. DD-012 register = internal, **not independent proof**. | “Title … evidenced by the Company share register at DD-012.” | **Self-serving register** – no ASIC search, no encumbrance check, no authority verification. | Title: independent evidence |

---

## 3. SPECIFIC RECOMMENDATIONS / MARK-UP INSTRUCTIONS

### A. Liability Regime (Clauses 12.1–12.3, 13, 9.3, 12.8, 20.5)
1.  **Cap:** Red-line 20% / AUD 4.8 M → **25% / AUD 6 M**.  Flag: *Fallback 20% requires Frost written authority – not obtained.*
2.  **Thresholds:** Red-line AUD 25 k / AUD 250 k excess-only → **AUD 5 k de minimis / AUD 50 k first-dollar basket**.
3.  **Time Limit:** Red-line 18 months → **24 months**.  Flag: *18-month fallback requires Frost approval – not obtained.*
4.  **“All Claims” Clause:** **Delete** “any limitation … applies to all Claims”.  Insert: *“Limitations in this Clause 12 apply only to General Warranty Claims.  Fundamental Claims, Title Claims, Tax Claims, IP Claims, Fraud Claims and Specific Indemnity Claims are governed by their respective clauses.”*
5.  **Fundamental/Title:** New clause – **100% cap, 6-year limit, no basket/de minimis/knowledge bar**.
6.  **Fraud Carve-out:** New clause – **“Nothing in this Agreement limits liability for fraud, wilful concealment
=== END ADVICE ===
